schema_note: schema_version 1. shorts[] metrics views/likes/comments/duration_s/thumbnail_width/thumbnail_height are copied from YouTube Data API fields or null when the response omits them. hook_pattern is a fixed classifier on the description's first line, else the title, and null when neither matches. visual_style_notes is empty unless thumbnail dimensions or a style word inside tags are present. trending_topics[] keep source and published_at (null if the source had no date). quota.used_units counts units this job charged, not YouTube's remaining quota.
